description: Hailing from Guangdong, China, Hush bends reality with telekinetic prowess on the battlefield. As an elusive Duelist, she manipulates enemy positions, creates gravity fields, and repositions through mid-air space with supreme precision.

role.description: Les duellistes sont des combattants indépendants. Leur équipe compte sur eux pour tuer un maximum d'adversaires et provoquer des combats.

abilities.description: Allows interaction with objects, switches, dropped weapons, and the Spike from an extended distance without standing directly on top of them.
Anchor marker mobility tool. Dash to the anchor after a short delay, with mid-air hover activation for unpredictable vertical repositioning.
Projectile flashbang with steerable detonation mechanics designed to blind enemies holding defensive angles.
Throws a telekinetic charge that forcefully drags nearby enemies toward the epicenter. Slamming into surfaces or players applies concuss.
Summons and steers a telekinetic orb that suspends enemies caught in its radius into the air, leaving them exposed and helpless.
